messages:
Evan Park: opened PR to update Sylph-9B model card: add supported quant variants, clarify context limits, and include SDK v2 streaming + embed migration snippets -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5010 :wave:
Nina Gupta: quick skim  the limits row is confusing. can we split into 'recommended_context' and 'hard_limit'? users keep assuming hard_limit is safe for production
Tom Reyes: agree. also the JS streaming example is using old API `client.streamResponses()`  should be `client.responses.stream()` in SDK v2. i'll push a tiny commit to fix it
Evan Park: thanks Tom. also note: Sylph-9b-4q uses grouped quant (grp=4) and on Dedicated you must set `--quant-grp=4` or it will be marked incompatible. adding a one-liner in compat section
docs-bot: lint: 3 style issues; linkcheck: broken link model-card/sylph9b/benchmarks (404)
Nina Gupta: bench link should point to s3://bench-results/sylph9b/2026-04/summary.csv. i'll update and add a short sentence about p95 tail latency increasing past 2048 seq
Tom Reyes: pushed the SDK v2 fixes and an embeddings migration snippet noting new embed dim = 1536 (old 1024). added migration checklist: reindex vectors, update schema, run sample queries
Evan Park: updated doc text, fixed bench link, addressed lint. merging in 10 unless objections :rocket:
docs-bot: PR #5010 checks passed (lint, linkcheck, examples)
